_comment: The eight agents of the study as a grid (section 5.1.5, Table 5.5): each LLM in its native harness (odd numbers) and in OpenCode (even numbers), so the two agents of a harness pair are next to each other. The runner copies an agent's entry into every run manifest. Deviations are from the harness's defaults; 'approved' gives the date the author approved a deviation that was not in the original spec. Renumbered 2026-10-15 from the void first pilot: old A5 -> A1, old A1 -> A2, old A6 -> A7, old A2 -> A8; A3-A6 are new.

grid._comment: Rows hold the LLM constant (RQ2, contrasts C3-C6), columns the harness (RQ1, C1 and C2).

A3.model_id_source: confirmed by the author 2026-10-15; listed by the Claude subscription's /v1/models and OpenRouter's catalogue

A4.model_id_source: confirmed by the author 2026-10-15; listed by the Claude subscription's /v1/models and OpenRouter's catalogue

cost_sources._comment: Where each agent's cost comes from (section 5.1.8; decided 2026-10-05, per agent since 2026-10-15). A value that is not reported is recorded as missing, never estimated.

sources.claude-code: total_cost_usd from Claude Code's result event (computed by Claude Code at Anthropic's API prices; under the subscription login this is not a bill).
sources.opencode: One OpenRouter API key per OpenCode agent (A2, A4, A6, A8; agents.json openrouter_key_file, limit 50 USD each), used by nothing else: a run's cost is its agent's key's usage after the run minus its usage before it, read from OpenRouter's /api/v1/key once the value has stopped changing (after it has reached 0.9 x the run's own request costs). Valid because an agent's runs never overlap; includes all requests of the run, also the title request.
sources.agy: agy's token counts from its result event, priced at Google's list price for gemini-3.8-flash; the price used is stored in the manifest.

cost_sources.opencode_approved: 2026-10-06: shared key with usage difference instead of one key per run (no provisioning key)
cost_sources.opencode_changed: 2026-10-15, after the Corridor pilot: one key per OpenCode agent instead of one key shared by all four (OpenRouter posted a run's usage 3-19 min late, so a shared key made every OpenCode run wait for the previous one's cost)

transcript_check._comment: Fixed 2026-10-05, before the pilot. Applied by pilot/transcript_check.py after every run.
transcript_check.rule: A call to any tool other than the 8 NAO tools is a protocol violation, and the run counts as a failure. Exception, A7 only: calls to manage_task, list_resources and read_resource are not violations (shown to give no outside information or effect), and neither are calls to view_file on an image agy offloaded from a NAO tool result or on the file in which agy puts the naoqi server's instructions (view_file_allowed_path); they are counted per run and reported. view_file on any other path is a violation.
transcript_check.rule_changed: 2026-10-06: view_file on offloaded tool-result images and on agy's copy of the naoqi server's instructions exempt for A7 (A6 before the renumbering of 2026-10-15) (agy shows both to the model only through view_file)

opencode.what: Built-in tools denied: permissions deny all except naoqi_* (global and build-agent rules) plus a hard-deny policy; denied tools are not offered to the LLM
Code Mode off: codemode false for the naoqi server, and the execute action denied
Prompt submitted only after OpenCode reports the naoqi MCP server as connected (OpenCode 2 connects MCP servers asynchronously); t0 = prompt submission
Title agent uses the run's own model and provider instead of OpenCode's default small model
Provider use limited to OpenRouter by policy; update disabled; sharing disabled
Network: only openrouter.ai reachable; models.opencode.ai (model catalog) blocked

claude-code.what: --tools "": all built-in tools off; in this mode Claude Code offers no end-conversation tool
--strict-mcp-config with the naoqi server as the only MCP server; its tools pre-approved (permissions.allow mcp__naoqi)
Network: only api.anthropic.com reachable; all other hosts (e.g. telemetry) blocked
Claude Code 2.1.295 (the version on the author's Mac on 2026-10-15) instead of 2.1.280: 2.1.280 does not know Claude Haiku 5.5 and reports its cost at Sonnet's price

agy.what: agy 1.2.17 instead of 1.2.16, the version on the author's Mac (1.2.16 has no Linux download)
NAO tools set to eager (offered directly as mcp_naoqi_<tool>) instead of agy's default lazy loading through call_mcp_tool

Custom agent 'nao' (agents/nao/agent.md, started with --agent nao): tools: [view_file] and inheritMcp: true, so no built-in tools except view_file (agy shows a tool result's image to the model only when the model opens the offloaded file with it) and manage_task, list_resources and read_resource, which agy cannot remove; its '# identity' section copies agy's default identity text verbatim, so the system prompt equals agy's default except the sections for the removed tools (skills, subagents, conversation transcript, slash commands) and one messaging line

Permission rules deny command, unsandboxed, write_file, read_url, execute_url; read_file allowed only under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/ (agy's offloaded tool-result images; a general read_file deny would override the allow); any other read is auto-denied in headless mode, which ends the session; mcp(naoqi/*) allowed; /work trusted

Network: only daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com, oauth2.googleapis.com, www.googleapis.com and lh3.googleusercontent.com reachable; feature flags (antigravity-unleash.goog), logging (play.googleapis.com) and the update server blocked. agy's eligibility check before every prompt needs www.googleapis.com (/oauth2/v2/userinfo) and lh3.googleusercontent.com (the account's profile picture); found with pilot/tools/agy_hosts_check.sh. The proxy filters by host, so these hosts' other Google services are reachable for agy too (not for the agent, which has only the NAO tools)
